title: Can Agents Trust Their Skills? Uncovering Unsafe Chains of Trust in Skill-Based LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.39065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on installable skills, which are packages of instructions, code, and resources that equip them with task-specific capabilities and, once installed, can be automatically invoked across subsequent user tasks. This creates a chain of trust in which users delegate authority to agents, while agent frameworks admit skill-provided content into the agents' context with insufficient validation, allowing malicious skills to influence agent behavior under that delegated authority. Yet, little is known about whether this trust model adequately constrains untrusted skill content before it reaches security-sensitive operations, or how frequently such trust violations arise in real-world agents. We present TrustProbe, a framework for uncovering unsafe chains of trust in skill-based LLM agents. translated_title: 智能体能信任它们的技能吗？揭示基于技能的LLM智能体中的不安全信任链
translated_abstract: LLM智能体日益依赖可安装的技能，这类技能是指令、代码和资源的集合包，为智能体提供特定任务的能力，并且一旦安装，便可在后续用户任务中被自动调用。这形成了一条信任链：用户将权限委托给智能体，而智能体框架在缺乏充分验证的情况下，允许技能提供的内容进入智能体的上下文，从而让恶意技能能够在该委托权限下影响智能体的行为。然而，目前鲜有研究探讨这种信任模型是否能在不可信的技能内容到达安全敏感操作之前对其加以充分约束，以及这类信任违规在真实世界智能体中出现的频率。我们提出了TrustProbe，一个用于揭示基于技能的LLM智能体中不安全信任链的框架。首先，TrustProbe通过分析智能体源代码，识别从技能控制的输入到安全敏感（操作）的源到汇（source-to-sink）调用路径……
tldr: 提出TrustProbe框架，通过分析智能体源代码追踪从技能控制输入到安全敏感操作的调用路径，揭示基于技能的LLM智能体中因验证不足而形成的不安全信任链。
en_tdlr: TrustProbe, a framework that uncovers unsafe chains of trust in skill-based LLM agents by analyzing agent source code to trace source-to-sink call paths from skill-controlled inputs to security-sensitive operations.
